description: carefree 可以表示沒有煩惱、性格隨和、沒有憂慮、氣氛輕鬆、身心放鬆、不擔心某件事、天生樂天，或若無其事地不在意。不同近義詞的核心差別，是『state vs personality』『worry vs tension』『cheerful tone vs lack of concern』『temporary vs habitual』。

words.meaning: 無憂無慮的；沒有煩惱的
words.note: 和 carefree 很接近，當重點是某人沒有明顯煩惱、壓力或困擾時，untroubled 很自然。它比 carefree 稍書面，也可形容平靜、不受問題影響的狀態。
words.example: She looked untroubled despite the confusion around her.
words.exampleZh: 儘管四周一片混亂，她看起來仍然毫無憂色。

exercises.original: She looked carefree even while everyone else was worrying about the delay.
exercises.zh: 其他人都在擔心延誤時，她看起來仍然毫無憂色。
exercises.upgrade: She looked untroubled even while everyone else was worrying about the delay.
